sentences.l2: 在中国古代，人们很早就会用木板印刷文字。
sentences.l1: In ancient China, people learned very early to print text using wooden blocks.

sentences.l2: 后来，有人发明了活字印刷。
sentences.l1: Later, someone invented movable type printing.

sentences.l2: 这种方法让印书变得更快。
sentences.l1: This method made printing books faster.

sentences.l2: 到了欧洲，一个叫古腾堡的人也发明了类似的印刷机。
sentences.l1: In Europe, a man called Gutenberg also invented a similar printing press.

sentences.l2: 他用金属做成一个个字母，可以重复使用。
sentences.l1: He made individual letters out of metal, which could be used repeatedly.

sentences.l2: 这样印书比以前快多了，也便宜多了。
sentences.l1: This way, printing books was much faster than before, and also much cheaper.

sentences.l2: 以前的书籍很少，只有富人或寺庙才有。
sentences.l1: In the past, books were very scarce; only the rich or temples had them.

sentences.l2: 普通人读不到书。
sentences.l1: Ordinary people could not get books to read.

sentences.l2: 印刷术出现后，书籍开始大量生产。
sentences.l1: After printing appeared, books began to be mass-produced.

sentences.l2: 很多人第一次能自己买书读。
sentences.l1: Many people could buy books to read on their own for the first time.

sentences.l2: 知识不再只属于少数人。
sentences.l1: Knowledge no longer belonged only to a few people.

sentences.l2: 印刷术帮助知识传播得更广。
sentences.l1: Printing helped knowledge spread more widely.

sentences.l2: 学校越来越多，人们开始学习科学、历史和医学。
sentences.l1: Schools became more and more numerous, and people began to study science, history and medicine.

sentences.l2: 虽然不是所有人都能立刻读书，但识字的人慢慢变多了。
sentences.l1: Although not everyone could read right away, the number of literate people slowly grew.

sentences.l2: 城市里出现了书店和图书馆。
sentences.l1: Bookstores and libraries appeared in cities.

sentences.l2: 有些人专门写书，成为作家。
sentences.l1: Some people wrote books full-time and became writers.

sentences.l2: 古腾堡的印刷机改变了世界。
sentences.l1: Gutenberg's printing press changed the world.

sentences.l2: 它让信息更容易被普通人得到。
sentences.l1: It made information easier for ordinary people to obtain.

sentences.l2: 虽然现在我们有电脑和手机，但书籍仍然是学习知识的重要方式。
sentences.l1: Although we now have computers and mobile phones, books are still an important way to learn knowledge.

sentences.l2: 今天的教科书、小说和报纸，都和几百年前的印刷技术有关。
sentences.l1: Today's textbooks, novels and newspapers are all related to the printing technology of several hundred years ago.

sentences.l2: 可以说，没有印刷术的发明，就没有现代教育的普及。
sentences.l1: It can be said that without the invention of printing, there would be no spread of modern education.
